summary.headline: Astrological Questions and Inceptions
summary.text: Astrological catalogue entries 58–78 covering ship arrivals and departures, war and enemy attacks, accusations, hidden things, aphrodisiacs, divination, illness, surgery, food for the sick, letters, taking to bed, absent persons, and related inceptions. The entries cite Athens, Smyrna, Alexandria, Demetrius, Julian, Hermes, and Julian of Laodicea, with astrological judgments based on the Moon, planets, zodiac signs, and planetary names such as Phaenon and Stilbon.
